input.explanation: No. The fault and the fix are both in this repository. `record_a_purchase` sends the write through `record_purchase_deriving_the_month`, which now hands off to `record_purchase` and so moves `total_this_month_cents` again. Once this is deployed, every new purchase keeps the stored month total right, whether the flag is on or off, and nothing outside the repo has to change. The records already written are fixed by scripts/repair_monthly_totals.py, which is also in this patch. It still needs a person to run it against the production records, but that is running a script, not changing code anywhere else.
